content:
elaine: noticing a spike of alerts for notify-gateway, seems like a filter rotation rolled and is dropping pages to #incident. incident-bot didn't escalate.

samir: yep saw the noise, about 40 suppressed events in queue. logs show rotation loop every ~30s.

incident-bot: ERROR: heartbeat miss for connector gateway-42 (last_seen: 2026-03-18T11:07:10Z). auto-suppression enabled.

marta: oncall was paged but handoff didn't happen — aaron missed two pages. looks like channel-mirror failed during rotation.

samir: posting relevant logs: ```json
{"t":"2026-03-18T11:06:58Z","svc":"gateway","msg":"filter rotation start","id":"gw-42"}
{"t":"2026-03-18T11:07:01Z","svc":"gateway","msg":"filter rotation apply","id":"gw-42","dropped":37}
```

harpreet: temporary mitigation: disabling automated filter-rotation in prod for gateway-42, will re-enable after fix. I'm on it.

elaine: can someone manually escalate current suppressed pages to paging provider? @marta can you call out ops-runbook step 3?

marta: doing manual ringdown now, pinging phone tree. also opening a short-lived dedicated channel for coordination.

ops-bot: deploy 9f3b2 promoted to prod by harpreet — note: feature toggle rotation enabled.

samir: that deploy toggled the rotation back on, might be why the loop restarted. can we rollback? if not, toggle off.

harpreet: rolling back to 9f3b1 and turning off rotation. ETA ~4m.

incident-bot: notice: backlog size 42, suppression window active. sending manual page flood to oncall (override).

marta: confirmed pages delivered via manual path. Aaron responded, triage started.

elaine: root cause hypothesis: new rotation worker doubles up and races with TTL refresh; will capture crash dump. follow-up postmortem after stabilization.

samir: filing ticket INFRA-2248 with logs and crash snippet. assign to harpreet + eng-runtime.

harpreet: after rollback, heartbeat stabilized. monitoring shows no further suppressions. leaving rotation disabled until patch.

marta: customer impact: ~12 customers reported delayed notifications in last 15m, outreach team notified.

elaine: thanks all — keep this thread for final status. I'll open incident page and link runbook.
